create_graphs_tuple: create a GraphsTuple instance with nodes, edges, globals, receivers, senders, n_node, and n_edge fields
validate_graphs_tuple: validate GraphsTuple None field constraints ensuring n_node and n_edge are not None and receivers/senders are consistent
replace_graphs_tuple_field: replace one or more fields of a GraphsTuple instance while validating None field constraints
map_graphs_tuple_fields: apply a function to feature fields of a GraphsTuple and return a new instance with transformed values
access_graph_field_constants: access graph field name constants such as NODES, EDGES, RECEIVERS, SENDERS, GLOBALS, N_NODE, and N_EDGE
